subject: chemistry
content: A student has been given 0.314 g of an organic compound and asked to estimate Sulphur. During the experiment, the student has obtained 0.4813 g of barium sulphate. The percentage of sulphur present in the compound is _________. (Given Molar mass in g mol−1 S: 32, BaSO4: 233)
